check: verify the Tan's Huge Trees and TYG entry, whose stated reason was the thinnest of the thirteen
why: The entry said only 'Recorded as blocked rather than run' and its howToRunIt repeated the same words without saying why. Every other entry names a reason, so this one was traced to the source that blocked it.

whatItSaid.item: Tan's Huge Trees and TYG write-set certification
whatItSaid.why: Recorded as blocked rather than run
whatItSaid.howToRunIt: Requires those mods present and their write sets certified, which is recorded as blocked rather than run

theSubstantiveReasonNotFoundUntilNow.text: S1C vegetation suppression and the actual lifecycle switch are unimplemented. A profile with insufficient Tan's Huge Trees protection still refuses authorization; the S5 full package stays BLOCKED, and no mod was deleted to fake compatibility.
theSubstantiveReasonNotFoundUntilNow.whatThatMeans: The block is a deliberate refusal, not a missing feature. A profile whose protection set does not cover what Tan's Huge Trees writes is denied authorization, and rather than removing the mod to make the package load, the package is held back.

theRefusalIsImplemented.ProtectionSnapshot: Throws a WallFailure with code MISSING_FEATURES_PLAN when protection is captured before FEATURES completed, and T0_CORRUPT when the snapshot hash mismatches.
theRefusalIsImplemented.OwnershipGuard: Throws on a write to a protected block, so protection is enforced at the point of mutation rather than only checked in advance.
theRefusalIsImplemented.consequence: So the entry's 'blocked' describes a mechanism that actively refuses, which is the opposite of an unimplemented gap.

whyTheWordingWasTooThin: Saying 'recorded as blocked rather than run' is accurate but omits the part a reader needs: that the block is a refusal on protection grounds and that removing the mod was explicitly declined. The howToRunIt restated the why, which added nothing.
whatWouldBeAdded: The entry should name the reason and cite the source, so a reader can tell a deliberate refusal from an untested path - those two look identical when an entry only says 'blocked'.
